policies.name: Two gates
policies.desc: Gate 1 decides whether an artifact EXISTS for a viewer (audience). Gate 2 decides which ROWS and fields a viewer sees inside it (data scope). They are administered separately.

policies.name: Counts are computed
policies.desc: Every count on this screen — "sees 118 of 118" — is derived from the approvals roster at paint time, never typed.

policies.name: Rule shape
policies.desc: A person is full-scope, or restricted by exactly one basis field plus optional masks.

policies.name: Legal basis
policies.desc: A field qualifies as a restriction basis only if every one of its values is known on every row (facility, customer system, approval status, field class).

policies.name: Customer confidential information
policies.desc: Profile composition and process descriptions are customer confidential business information (terms clause 14.1). A billing reader sees prices, invoices and surcharges, never composition.

policies.name: Correspondence is runtime
policies.desc: Mailbox content is read at question time under the reader's permissions and never becomes a graph fact or a cached figure.

policies.name: Retention
policies.desc: Receipts, manifests and lab results are kept for the retention period the permits and 40 CFR 264.74 require; deletion requests apply to derived datasets and cached answers only.
